shared: Companions at an oval table look at one phone and share a plate; one ticket appears.
separate: Strangers sit apart at opposite ends of one communal table, each using their own phone; two tickets appear.
trigger: Once on entrance; replay tickets on pointer entry or keyboard focus. Never loops or delays the real action. Never crossfade friends into strangers.
reducedMotion: Complete static scene; preference change immediately settles motion.
semantics: Illustrations, not live diner counts. Existing share and separate-group handlers alone own state changes. No automatic group creation from animation.
